profile: multi-output regression: a regression problem with multiple outputs. Nonlinear feature engineering can be applied, and a key design choice is whether to model each output separately with a nonlinear model per output, or jointly with a single nonlinear model that predicts all outputs simultaneously. Multi-output regression was introduced in the context of linear regression.
